endorsements.name: Gareth Catterall
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-4599
endorsements.description: The fragment preview functionality in Liferay Portal 7.4.3.61 through 7.4.3.132, and Liferay DXP 2024.Q4.1 through 2024.Q4.5, 2024.Q3.1 through 2024.Q3.13, 2024.Q2.0 through 2024.Q2.13, 2024.Q1.1 through 2024.Q1.13 and 7.4 update 61 through update 92 was found to be vulnerable to postMessage-based XSS because it allows a remote non-authenticated attacker to inject JavaScript into the fragment portlet URL.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 4.0, 2)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
